standard_prerequisites.name: The base change of a flat ring map is flat
standard_prerequisites.use: Keeps the map C tensor_A C -> C tensor_B C flat.

standard_prerequisites.name: The composition of flat ring maps is flat
standard_prerequisites.use: Composes the two flat maps in the factorization and gives part (2).

core_obligations: Part (1): the multiplication map C tensor_A C -> C factors as C tensor_A C -> C tensor_B C -> C; the isomorphism C tensor_B C = (C tensor_A C) tensor_{B tensor_A B} B identifies the first map as the base change of the flat map B tensor_A B -> B, hence flat, and the second map is the base change of the flat map C tensor_B C -> C along B -> C (or directly flat as a base change of a flat map), so the composition is flat by closure of flat maps under base change and composition (proof lines 30358-30369). Part (2): weak etaleness of A -> B and B -> C says exactly that B tensor_A B -> B and C tensor_B C -> C are flat, so part (1) gives C tensor_A C -> C flat, and the remaining multiplicativity condition is inherited since A -> B -> C are multiplicative; the composition of flat maps fact just used completes the argument (proof lines 30370-30371).
proof_roadmap: Factor the multiplication through C tensor_B C and use base change plus composition closure of flat maps (proof lines 30358-30369).
Deduce weak etaleness of the composition from part (1) (proof lines 30370-30371).
